  p.dec,
  p.type,

rows.question: Show me all photometrically observable star
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photo_type_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    value::integer AS value,
    name::text AS name,
    description::text AS description
  FROM photo_type
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  pt.name AS type_name,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd,
  p.loadversion
FROM photoobj p
JOIN photo_type_lookup pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
WHERE (pt.name ILIKE '%STAR%' OR pt.name = 'STAR')
  AND (
    p.u IS NOT NULL
    OR p.g IS NOT NULL
    OR p.r IS NOT NULL
    OR p.i IS NOT NULL
    OR p.z IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY p.objid

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension and declination of photometrically observable Galaxy that have spectral observations.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH specobj_by_bestobjid AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
    s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.objid, p.ra, p.dec
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN specobj_by_bestobjid s_direct
  ON p.objid = s_direct.bestobjid
LEFT JOIN neighbors n
  ON p.objid = n.objid
LEFT JOIN specobj_by_bestobjid s_via_neighbor
  ON n.neighborobjid = s_via_neighbor.bestobjid
WHERE p.type = 3
  AND (s_direct.specobjid IS NOT NULL OR s_via_neighbor.specobjid IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY p.objid

rows.question: Show me the photometrically observed star with the following constraints in its color bands, u - g < 0.4, g - r < 0.7, r - i > 0.4 and i - z > 0.4
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_photometry_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid,
    p.run,
    p.rerun,
    p.field,
    p.mode,
    p.type,
    CASE WHEN p.clean IS NULL THEN NULL
         WHEN p.clean < 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE p.clean END AS clean,
    CASE WHEN p.flags IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.flags END AS flags,
    CASE WHEN p.rowc IS NULL OR p.rowc = 'NaN'::real THEN NULL ELSE p.rowc END AS rowc,
    CASE WHEN p.colc IS NULL OR p.colc = 'NaN'::real THEN NULL ELSE p.colc END AS colc,
    CASE WHEN p.cmodelmag_u IS NULL OR p.cmodelmag_u > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.cmodelmag_u END AS cmodelmag_u,
    CASE WHEN p.cmodelmag_g IS NULL OR p.cmodelmag_g > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.cmodelmag_g END AS cmodelmag_g,
    CASE WHEN p.cmodelmag_r IS NULL OR p.cmodelmag_r > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.cmodelmag_r END AS cmodelmag_r,
    -- cmodelmag_i and cmodelmag_z columns are not present in DDL; keep as NULL to match requested outputs
    NULL::real AS cmodelmag_i,
    NULL::real AS cmodelmag_z,
    CASE WHEN p.u IS NULL OR p.u > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.u END AS u,
    CASE WHEN p.g IS NULL OR p.g > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.g END AS g,
    CASE WHEN p.r IS NULL OR p.r > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.r END AS r,
    CASE WHEN p.i IS NULL OR p.i > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.i END AS i,
    CASE WHEN p.z IS NULL OR p.z > 90 THEN NULL ELSE p.z END AS z,
    CASE WHEN p.ra IS NULL OR p.ra = 'NaN'::double precision THEN NULL ELSE p.ra END AS ra,
    CASE WHEN p.dec IS NULL OR p.dec = 'NaN'::double precision THEN NULL ELSE p.dec END AS dec,
    CASE WHEN p.extinction_r IS NULL OR p.extinction_r < 0 THEN NULL ELSE p.extinction_r END AS extinction_r,
    CASE WHEN p.mjd IS NULL OR p.mjd < 0 THEN NULL ELSE p.mjd END AS mjd
  FROM photoobj AS p
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.cmodelmag_i,
  p.cmodelmag_z,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd
FROM photoobj_photometry_canonical p
JOIN photo_type t ON p.type = t.value
WHERE
  p.u IS NOT NULL
  AND p.g IS NOT NULL
  AND p.r IS NOT NULL
  AND p.i IS NOT NULL
  AND p.z IS NOT NULL
  AND (p.u - p.g) < 0.4
  AND (p.g - p.r) < 0.7
  AND (p.r - p.i) > 0.4
  AND (p.i - p.z) > 0.4
  AND t.name = 'STAR'
ORDER BY p.objid
